High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad

entities.label: PRECEDENT

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Case :- Application U/S 482 No. - 1042 of 2025
Applicant :- Jitendra Kumar Chauhan

Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. And 4 Others
Counsel for Applicant :- Sudarshan Singh
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.,Rakesh Kumar Singh
Hon'ble Vinod Diwakar,J.
1.
Heard learned counsel for the applicant, learned A.G.A. for the State-respondent and perused the entire record.

2. This application under Section 482 Cr.P.C. has been filed with a prayer to quash the summoning order dated 16.09.2019 passed by Additional Session Judge/Special Judge, POCSO Act, District Chandauli, as well as entire proceeding of S.S.T. No.76 of 2019 (State v. Jitendra Kumar Chauhan)
arising out of Case Crime No.304 of 2019, under Sections 363, 366, 376, 504, 506 I.P.C. and Section 3/4 POCSO Act, Police Station Ali Nagar, District Chandauli, on the basis of a compromise.

entities.text: Additional Session Judge/Special Judge, POCSO Act, District Chandauli
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
3. Learned counsel for the applicant submitted that since the parties had settled their dispute outside the court, therefore, concerned S.H.O. was directed to verify the compromise and parties were were directed to appear virtually through video conferencing before the court vide order dated 22.05.2025.
4.

In compliance of aforesaid order, the parties are present before this Court and on Court's query whether the matter has been compromised between them, they have stated that the matter has amicably been resolved between them.

sentences.text: 5. Per contra, learned A.G.A. submits that since the dispute between the parties has been settled and opposite party no.2 has no objection, therefore, the proceedings of the aforesaid case pending before the trial court be quashed.
6. I have considered the submissions made by the learned counsel for the parties, and have gone through the entire record.

7. Since the dispute between the parties has been amicably settled, no fruitful purpose would be served by permitting to continue the criminal case pending before the trial court and it would simply a waste of judicial time as chances of conviction are very bleak.

8. In such circumstances, the entire proceedings of summoning order dated 16.09.2019 passed by Additional Session Judge/Special Judge, POCSO Act, District Chandauli, as well as entire proceeding of S.S.T. No.76 of 2019 (State v. Jitendra Kumar Chauhan) arising out of Case Crime No.304 of 2019, under Sections 363, 366, 376, 504, 506 I.P.C. and Section 3/4 POCSO Act, Police Station Ali Nagar, District Chandauli, against the applicant, are hereby quashed.

entities.text: Additional Session Judge/Special Judge, POCSO Act, District Chandauli
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: 9. The instant petition stands allowed, accordingly.

Order Date :- 29.5.2025 /A.N. Mishra (Vinod Diwakar,J.)
